run_bm_ball_query: run the bm_ball_query benchmark function to measure ball query performance across CPU and CUDA backends
benchmark_ball_query_square: benchmark the ball_query_square operation with varying batch sizes, point counts, dimensions, K values, and radii
benchmark_ball_query_ragged: benchmark the ball_query_ragged operation with varying batch sizes, point counts, dimensions, K values, and radii
test_ball_query_square: test the TestBallQuery.ball_query_square static method with custom N, P1, P2, D, K, radius, and device parameters
test_ball_query_ragged: test the TestBallQuery.ball_query_ragged static method with custom N, P1, P2, D, K, radius, and device parameters
